VAT, €22,99/μήνα billed yearly); it is a payments/POS group, not one of the stored till players, recorded as focus pos. SumUp Greece (stored d0eb16fa): only a generic free online store with store pickup (0 € monthly, 2,75% transaction fee); no Greek Order & Pay page (/el-gr/order-and-pay/ is 404), so weak fit. MENU TIGER has a Greek-language site but prices only in USD. Zuna (zunapro.com/greece) answered 410 Gone. METRO's DISH Order has no Greek country page (dish.co/GR/el/... 404), not recorded.
